combo_only.about: Album-colour hint (Tiffany Oct 20 late, item J): an album's set colours are a HINT for missed colours, not a rule. Each album mat gets its set's colours as COMBO-ONLY colours (row field 10, FYM 'ha'; never a single-colour section) only where the mat photo measures >= 5% of that colour (blue + teal pooled for the blue/teal test). Never added when she removed that colour for the mat (corrections 'remove'). Derived by build_v5.py from site/livepatch/matgallery/album_combo_audit_oct20.json set colours + scratch album membership, list frozen in config/mat-album-combo-colors.json.

also_year_round.about: Holiday mats that ALSO match year-round (Tiffany Oct 21). They stay holiday mats (Holiday section; FYM hol=true) but ALSO show in their colour sections (gallery) and single-colour chips (FYM, flag ayr). 'sections' = the colour + mood sections, picked by claude-photo-review from the photo + measured shares (config/mat-accent-colors.json); measured accents are added by build_v5.py as usual. In the gallery row 'holiday' is the last section and a co-primary (so it sorts with the other holiday mats).

works_for_holiday.about: Year-round mats that ALSO work for the holidays (Tiffany Oct 21). They stay year-round (colour sections; FYM hol=false) and ALSO show at the BOTTOM of the gallery Holiday section under the subheading 'Year-round mats that work for the holidays' (row field 12 = 1), and count as holiday for FYM holiday tile sets (FYM flag wfh: setsForMat offers holiday tile sets for them).
